I teach across the economics curriculum at Angelo State University, with a focus on **causal inference** and **price theory**.

## Signature courses

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .theme-card}
### Quantitative Methods for the Social Sciences
Causal inference for applied research — research design, regression, difference-in-differences, and event studies, with hands-on data work.<br>
*Best for: advanced undergraduates*<br>
[Syllabus](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RMiYHE9U9AKX4XfchXAvD5HVZCmc6A52/view?usp=drive_link)
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .theme-card}
### Intermediate Microeconomics
Price theory in depth — consumer and producer behavior, market structure, and welfare, with an emphasis on economic intuition.<br>
*Best for: undergraduates*
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .theme-card}

Why some countries are rich and others poor — institutions, growth, poverty, and the political economy of development.<br>
[Syllabus](https://drive.google.com/file/d/19QV6zZQRZb8i408wkuyMC2quphvG-Ago/view?usp=drive_link)

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .theme-card}
